# Coverage limits

The D0 CPU rehearsals record executed lines in `COVERAGE_vsi.json` and `COVERAGE_revsi.json`, including the separate prompt-proof and full-checker subprocesses. `COVERAGE_LIMITS.json` lists all unobserved executable lines in the principal runtime files. Unobserved lines include error branches and unused step544 branches; they are not all Orchard-only.

The following operations require Orchard and were not executed: real runtime and model transfer, GCS credentials and object reads, the real namespace mount, real H100 admission, real processor loading, vLLM generation, GCS publication/readback, scheduler admission and submission, live governor registration, and network fetch. The mount, GPU and transport boundaries use local stand-ins. A fixed template stand-in passes the accepted prompt-byte proof, and the fake engine exercises the worker processor comparisons. Neither proves real-processor equivalence.
